resolved.resolution: Canonical formulas keep the internal ah#, ca, zā, zo, and ye particle members visible even when traditional writing is solid.
Canvas question marks, exclamation marks, and ellipses remain source witnesses; generated particle Results contain only grammatical particle material.
Cuix, mā, and tlā use their existing sentence controls and are not repeated in the general Particle control.
The application chooses ca# after mah and after mā or tlā in wish or command sentences; it chooses ah# elsewhere and after mā in an admonition.
Callers cannot directly choose ah# or ca#; the application chooses the allomorph, except that ah# remains licensed as the exceptional compound embed described in Lesson 3.
Stored honorificized entries cannot directly generate Results; the shared honorific operation derives ōtzin, āuhtzin, and ca no zotzin.
